description: This file defines the Contact controller class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling display and processing of the contact page including form rendering, form submission handling, validation, and success page rendering.

classes.name: Contact
classes.description: Controller class managing the contact page, handling display, form submissions, validation, and success handling for user contact interactions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares data and renders the contact page view with store info, location, captcha, and layout components.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles the submission of the contact form, performs validation, triggers email task if valid, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays the success page after a successful contact form submission.
